tools.name: search_funds
tools.description: Search the published instrument catalogue by name, ISIN or ticker; includes currency and listing identifiers. Returns checkUrl: a shareable link to the same result.

tools.name: xray_portfolio
tools.description: Analyze free-preview ETF overlap/concentration findings, known ongoing charges and regional/sector exposures from published evidence. Identify each holding with exactly one ISIN or ticker; a ticker can be ambiguous across exchanges. Use positive relative weights, values in one base currency, or omit

tools.name: compare_funds
tools.description: Analyze two ETFs as a 50/50 portfolio, with overlap and issuer facts including dated ongoing charges side by side, and each fund's own region and sector exposure. Identify each side with exactly one ISIN or ticker; a ticker can be ambiguous across exchanges. Unknown facts remain null. Returns checkU

tools.name: rank_funds
tools.description: Sort 2 to 10 funds by up to three published facts: ongoing charge, US share, pairwise overlap and holdings count. Rows follow the criteria in order. A missing fact sorts last and stays null; it is never estimated. Rates are decimal fractions (0.07 = 7%). Analysis based on published fund data. Return
